verdict.rationale: Letta supports self-hosting where 'agents can run entirely on infrastructure you control,' which lets a user determine exactly where data physically resides, and local CLI mode stores state on the user's own machine without cloud login. However, there is no evidence of an explicit region/residency selector for Letta Cloud (chat.letta.com, managed sandboxes) — missing for 10: managed-cloud region selection, data residency guarantees/certifications, and any documentation of where cloud-hosted agent data is stored.
